about: Maunga Whau (Mt Eden), Auckland: heights in metres on a 10 m x 10 m grid, 87 x 61 points, digitised from a topographic map by Ross Ihaka; R's datasets package (volcano), GPL-2 | GPL-3, CSV from Rdatasets (https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/csv/datasets/volcano.csv). R's documentation: 'These data should not be regarded as accurate.' heights[i * cols + j]: row i (x, 10 m apart), column j (y, 10 m apart), as R's image(volcano) draws them. Isolines every 10 m and the bands between them by contourpy, in grid units; palette viridis (Matplotlib). Written by figures/src/interactive_l07_gallery_data.py from figures/data/gallery/volcano.csv.
